$comment: Search concepts for the EMC Helpline welcome visual.
Every query is written to surface calm, abstract, supportive imagery.
Results are NEVER auto-approved: appearing in an image search is not a licence.
Excluded by policy: identifiable faces, minors, crying or cowering victims,
screenshots of harassment, padlocks over mouths, hooded-hacker cliches.

queries.intent: Welcome hero: reassurance and local relevance.
Privacy notice: confidentiality without surveillance imagery.
Reporting guidance: platforms shown abstractly, no logos.
Primary candidate for the welcome panel.

queries.query: parent helping teenager online safety illustration
queries.intent: Parent persona. Approve only if no identifiable minor appears.
